# Remote Control Agent v0.1.34

Spec #280 — retire the canceled Browser Handoff (Quick Tunnel OTP mobile takeover). This release removes handoff-specific Agent code and configuration while keeping the original browser automation, paired device identity, operation receipts and independent Issue #39 owner-approved upgrade functionality.

- Unchanged native browser automation contract; no `browser_handoff_*` operations.
- Revoked devices no longer admit queued or in-flight read/write work, including post-revocation read replies.
- Immutable, architecture-specific Windows x64, Linux x64 and Linux ARM64 native candidates with recorded SHA-256 digests.
- Preserves existing paired identities and local data. No pairing reset or rollback of the independent approved upgrade protocol.

This GitHub Release only makes reviewed candidate assets available; it **does not** upgrade any enrolled device or authorize a live version switch. Windows `v0.1.33` and WSL2 `v0.1.22` must be upgraded later through separately approved, attended actions with device identity and rollback acceptance.
